summary.goal: Add database schema for organizations, initiatives, and org membership to enable plan grouping and future multi-tenancy
summary.context: Current schema has plans as top-level entities with no context. Need org_id on plans (required), initiative_id on plans (optional), and supporting tables. Single implicit org for v1 (no UI picker).

acceptance_criteria.description: organizations table exists with org_id, name, slug, timestamps
initiatives table exists with initiative_id, org_id FK, name, description, status, icon, color, timestamps
org_members table exists with org_id, user_id, role (owner/admin/member)
plans table has org_id column (NOT NULL) with FK to organizations
plans table has initiative_id column (nullable) with FK to initiatives
plans table has owner_user_id column (nullable) for plan ownership
Default organization created on first run if none exists
Existing plans migrated to default org with null initiative_id
Zod schemas exist for Organization, Initiative, OrgMember domain types
REST endpoints exist: GET/POST /initiatives, GET/PUT/DELETE /initiatives/:id

steps.title: Add Organization, Initiative, OrgMember Zod schemas
steps.description: Create src/domain/organization.ts with Zod schemas for Organization, Initiative, OrgMember, and InitiativeStatus enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: OrganizationSchema: { org_id: uuid, name: string, slug: string, created_at: datetime, updated_at: datetime }

InitiativeSchema: { initiative_id: uuid, org_id: uuid, name: string, description?: string, status: 'active'|'completed'|'archived', icon?: string, color?: string, display_order: number, created_at, updated_at }
OrgMemberSchema: { org_id: uuid, user_id: string, role: 'owner'|'admin'|'member', created_at }
Export createOrganization(), createInitiative() factory functions

steps.title: Add new tables to schema.ts
steps.description: Add CREATE_ORGANIZATIONS_TABLE, CREATE_INITIATIVES_TABLE, CREATE_ORG_MEMBERS_TABLE to src/storage/schema.ts with proper indexes.

acceptance_criteria.description: organizations table: org_id PK, name, slug UNIQUE, timestamps
initiatives table: initiative_id PK, org_id FK, name, description, status, icon, color, display_order, timestamps
org_members table: composite PK (org_id, user_id), role, created_at
Index on initiatives(org_id) for fast filtering

steps.title: Add org_id, initiative_id, owner_user_id columns to plans
steps.description: Modify CREATE_PLANS_TABLE to include org_id (NOT NULL FK), initiative_id (nullable FK), owner_user_id (nullable). Add migration support.

acceptance_criteria.description: plans.org_id column NOT NULL with FK to organizations(org_id)
plans.initiative_id column nullable with FK to initiatives(initiative_id)
plans.owner_user_id column nullable (string, no FK - external user system)
Index on plans(org_id) and plans(initiative_id)

steps.title: Update Plan domain type and storage interface
steps.description: Update PlanSchema in domain/plan.ts to include new fields. Update PlanStorage interface with new methods.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanSchema includes org_id: uuid, initiative_id?: uuid, owner_user_id?: string
createPlan(org_id, owner_user_id?) accepts new required/optional params
PlanStorage interface adds: createOrganization, getOrganization, listOrganizations
PlanStorage interface adds: createInitiative, getInitiative, updateInitiative, deleteInitiative, listInitiatives(org_id)
PlanStorage interface adds: listPlans filter param: { org_id?, initiative_id?, owner_user_id? }

steps.title: Implement storage methods in sqlite.ts
steps.description: Implement all new storage interface methods for organizations, initiatives, and updated plan queries.

acceptance_criteria.description: createOrganization inserts and returns Organization
getOrganization(org_id) returns Organization | null
createInitiative, getInitiative, updateInitiative, deleteInitiative work correctly
listInitiatives(org_id) returns Initiative[] ordered by display_order
listPlans accepts filter object and applies WHERE clauses
createPlan requires org_id parameter

steps.title: Add database migration for existing data
steps.description: Create migration that: (1) creates new tables, (2) creates default org, (3) adds columns to plans, (4) migrates existing plans to default org.

acceptance_criteria.description: Migration creates 'Default' organization with slug 'default'
Existing plans get org_id = default org's ID
Migration is idempotent (safe to run multiple times)
Migration runs automatically on server start

steps.title: Add Initiative REST endpoints
steps.description: Create src/api/handlers/initiatives.ts with CRUD endpoints. Wire into router.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /initiatives returns [{ initiative_id, org_id, name, description, status, icon, color, plan_count }]
GET /initiatives/:id returns { initiative_id, ..., plans: [{ plan_id, goal, status }] }
POST /initiatives accepts { name, description?, icon?, color? }, returns created Initiative
PUT /initiatives/:id accepts partial update, returns updated Initiative
DELETE /initiatives/:id returns 204 (soft delete via status='archived')
All endpoints scoped to implicit default org (no org_id param needed v1)

steps.title: Update plans endpoints with initiative filter
steps.description: Update GET /plans to accept initiative_id query param. Update POST /plans to accept initiative_id in body.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /plans?initiative_id=xxx returns only plans in that initiative
GET /plans response includes initiative_id and initiative: { name, icon, color } if set
POST /plans accepts optional initiative_id, associates plan with initiative
PUT /plans/:id allows changing initiative_id

steps.title: Add tests for new functionality
steps.description: Add unit tests for domain types, storage methods, and API endpoints.

acceptance_criteria.description: Organization/Initiative Zod schemas validate correctly
Storage CRUD operations tested with in-memory SQLite
Initiative API endpoints return expected shapes
Plan filtering by initiative_id works
Migration creates default org and migrates plans
